qualifier: adhesion and polarity, without costimulatory GTPase signalling
name: T cell adhesion, polarity and immunological synapse formation
rationale: All members concern T cell polarisation, raft localisation, aggregation and adhesion at the immunological synapse; unlike confusables built around CD28-Vav1, Rho GTPase and second-messenger signalling, this theme carries the T cell surface, adhesion and migration members.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: All three members are phenylalanine/tyrosine degradation, whereas confusables cover glycine, threonine and generic amino acid metabolism.

core: Bacterial adhesion and invasion of host cells
name: Gram-positive bacterial adhesion and invasion of epithelial cells
rationale: Members describe bacterial attachment to epithelium, InlA-mediated Listeria entry, actin-based motility and response to Gram-positive bacteria; confusables instead cover mycobacterial phagosome manipulation, toxins or antimicrobial peptide defence.

name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signalling
rationale: Members are GH, prolactin and leptin JAK-STAT receptor signalling, body growth regulation and thyroid hormone generation, transport and action; the thyroid arm separates it from IL-6-family/somatostatin confusables and the class I cytokine-receptor hormones from steroidogenic confusables.

name: Planar cell polarity establishment in epithelia
rationale: All members concern establishing planar polarity via asymmetric PCP protein localisation, while confusables are downstream convergent extension, neural plate and inner ear morphogenesis.

qualifier: nuclear receptor transcription and vitamin D synthesis
name: SREBP and nuclear receptor control of sterol synthesis
rationale: Members are SREBP activation, cholesterol homeostasis and SREBF promoter-motif sets plus nuclear receptor transcription, receptor SUMOylation and vitamin D biosynthesis regulation; the nuclear receptor and vitamin members are what confusables (ER lipid transport, ATF6/CREB3, ChREBP) lack.

qualifier: telomerase recruitment to telomeres plus snRNA/rRNA modification
name: Cajal body telomerase trafficking and small RNA modification
rationale: Members cover scaRNA/telomerase RNA localisation to Cajal bodies, telomerase assembly and telomere extension alongside snRNA/rRNA modification; telomerase extension separates it from snoRNP/RNA-modification confusables and RNA modification from telomere-capping confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation of proliferation; naive and memory B cell signatures
name: Positive regulation of B cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: All members are B cell activation, proliferation, differentiation and B/lymphocyte expression signatures; confusables emphasise germinal centre/Tfh, memory, or negative BCR regulation, whereas this theme carries positive regulation and naive/memory B cell modules.

name: MET receptor downstream effector signalling
rationale: Every member is MET activating an effector (RAS, STAT3, PTPN11, PI3K/AKT, RAP1/RAC1) or its drug inhibition, while confusables are generic PI3K/AKT, ALK/LTK or IGF1R signalling.

name: Adrenal and gonadal steroid hormone biosynthesis
rationale: Members are CYP-mediated pregnenolone, corticosteroid, androgen, estrogen and progesterone synthesis and their defects; the sex-steroid members separate it from corticosteroid-secretion confusables and the steroid focus from vitamin D/retinoid CYP confusables.

name: Interleukin-4 and interleukin-13 production and signalling
rationale: All members are IL-4/IL-13 production or signalling, whereas confusables centre on Th2 differentiation, IL-5, mast cells and eosinophils.

qualifier: glucose-6-phosphate handling and inherited storage disorders
name: Glycogen and glucose-6-phosphate metabolism and inherited disorders
rationale: Members are glycogen synthesis, breakdown, glycophagy and the glycogen storage diseases, plus glucokinase, G6PC/SLC37A4 and PGM1 glucose-6-phosphate handling; confusables cover glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and fructose metabolism instead.

qualifier: skeletal myogenesis and regeneration plus cardiomyocyte growth
name: Skeletal and cardiac muscle differentiation, growth and regeneration
rationale: Members span myoblast proliferation, fusion and differentiation, satellite cell regeneration, sarcomere assembly, contraction, hypertrophy/atrophy and cardiomyocyte growth; confusables are calcium/phosphatase signalling, heart morphogenesis or smooth muscle.

name: Glycolysis to lactate and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control
rationale: Members are glucose catabolism through hexokinase and fructose bisphosphates to lactate, with fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation; confusables address pentose phosphate regulation, glucagon signalling or glycogen.

qualifier: inhibitory KIR and MHC class I recognition
name: NK cell cytotoxicity under KIR and MHC class I control
rationale: Members cover NK degranulation, granzyme killing and cytokine production, KIR and NK receptor modules, MHC class Ib presentation and protection from NK killing; confusables emphasise positive cytotoxicity regulation or T cell costimulation.

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members are microglial differentiation, activation and migration with apoptotic cell recognition, phosphatidylserine exposure and engulfment; confusables involve DAP12, scavenger receptors, amyloid-beta or lipoprotein clearance.

name: Reactive oxygen species detoxification with MTF1 metal-responsive transcription
rationale: Members are ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, HMOX1 regulation and dampened oxidoreductase activity together with MTF1 gene activation; MTF1 and oxidoreductase restraint separate it from the closest ROS confusable, and ROS detox from nitrosative and metallothionein confusables.

name: Amino and organic acid metabolism with aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members are broad amino acid and organic acid metabolism plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate in mitochondria; the conjugation members are absent from threonine, glycine and proline confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle orientation
rationale: Members are AURKA-TPX2 activation, NuMA and centrosome protein recruitment and astral microtubule-driven spindle positioning; confusables cover interphase centrosome/cilia biology or the broader mitotic progression machinery.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide production and turnover, oxygen sensing
name: Reactive oxygen species production, hydrogen peroxide turnover and detoxification
rationale: Members combine ROS detoxification, superoxide and hydrogen peroxide generation and catabolism, oxygen detection, selenium response and BACH1-HMOX1 regulation; ROS/H2O2 production and oxygen sensing are what the nitrosative-stress and MTF1 confusables lack.
Members mix generic protein oligomerisation terms, magnesium ion transport, multi-pass ER membrane insertion and the NLRP1 inflammasome, which share no specific biological theme.

name: Microglial differentiation, proliferation, migration and activation
rationale: All members concern microglial development, proliferation, migration, activation and cytotoxicity with lysosome organisation; confusables centre on amyloid-beta handling, DAP12 signalling or apoptotic cell clearance.

qualifier: Dectin C-type lectin receptors and interleukin-23
name: Dectin C-type lectin antifungal signalling and interleukin-23 production
rationale: Members are Dectin-1/Dectin-2 family signalling, fungal recognition and IL-23 induction; confusables are IL-1/IL-17/IL-18 cytokine signalling or Th1/IL-12 responses.

core: RNA polymerase II early elongation and pausing
name: RNA polymerase II early elongation and Tat-driven HIV-1 transcription
rationale: Members cover Pol II promoter clearance, pausing, early elongation complex formation and the HIV-1 Tat-dependent versions of these steps; confusables address initiation, promoter escape or termination without the Tat elongation set.

core: Water-soluble vitamin and nutrient amine metabolism
qualifier: choline, carnitine, thiamine and riboflavin with FMO oxidation
name: Choline, carnitine, thiamine and riboflavin metabolism and transport
rationale: Members are synthesis, catabolism and transport of choline, carnitine, thiamine and riboflavin plus FMO3 oxidation of choline-derived trimethylamine; confusables cover sulfur/selenium, cobalamin, biotin, folate or fatty acid oxidation.
